title: V07 · FAQ:
headline: After surgery you always hear what happened: a real update, sometimes years later, like Elias, who is in school and thriving.
story: Mackinnon answers the FAQ in one take. Every donor gets a post-treatment update: a photo, a quote, a note from the medical team. They're real. Then the proof: Elias in Ethiopia, three surgeries, nineteen donors, and seven years later he is in school and thriving. We show his real profile and his real photos.

Then the honest beat (some updates are complicated, and Watsi shares those too), what donors do with updates, and the button: a moment of connection. Loops: L1 the question opens at 0:00 and closes at “you'll always know”. L2 “What happened to Elias?” closes on “He's thriving.” Hopeful, never sad.
do: Question on screen at 0:00, at least 5 s.
Show Elias's real profile on “Nineteen people funded them.”
Show Sonam's photos of Elias on “Seven years later”.
Keep every caption and graphic fully inside the frame.
Keep her order. One take: Mincho5152.
dont: No photo of Elias beside the toilet chair.
No logo or Watsi corner bug before the end card.
No surgery, wound or condition pictures.
Don't mix in lines from Mincho5150 or 5151 unless a refresh asks for them.

tech: The other Medellín Mackinnon takes probe 3840×2160, 23.976 fps, H.264, 2-ch audio in camera. Confirm on import.
1080×1920 at 23.976 fps, same as the source.
A 9:16 crop of 4K is 1215×2160, so punch-ins up to about 112% stay sharp. Grade before export: skin natural, windows not blown out.
2 channels in camera. Pick the live channel on the waveform, map it to both sides, mute the other.
−14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP peak. Bed at least 12 dB under her voice.

Lato Bold, white, soft shadow, large. Pop word by word, one line at a time. No box, no highlight, no shading block. On screen the whole time, also in pauses (no flash gaps). Fix every WOTC / WotC to Watsi by hand. Keep the bottom 20% clear for app buttons. Every line fits inside the frame with a margin: nothing cut off at the edges.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, about 16 Mbps. One file, 9:16 only.
checklist: Frame 1 is Mackinnon with <q>What happens after surgery?</q> already on screen. No logo, no fade.
No text is cut off at any edge: captions, top text, name super (Atdhe, 3 Nov).
Every caption reads Watsi, capital W only; watsi.org lowercase on the end card.
Elias's profile on screen is the real page, recorded clean.
Only Sonam's photos of Elias, never the toilet-chair photo.
No soft shot where a sharper one exists (Atdhe, 3 Nov).
Name super “Mackinnon” is large, first name only, never at 0:00.
Captions never drop out. No flash gaps.
Check by ear: “a patient's care” and “or their family”.

decisions.b: Sonam's 17 Sep question-first treatment (question typed first, bold yellow, moving picture behind it) is still not confirmed for the Batch #5 FAQs. This plan opens on the question in white over her face. If Nick or Atdhe confirm the treatment, make it yellow #FFCC33.
The v3 cut carries a Watsi bug from 0:03. The house rule is no logo before the end card, so this plan has none. Nick decides if the FAQ series keeps the bug.
